lines.text: MERCADO MUNICIPAL DE BOCAS DEL TORO-ISLA COLON

expect.query: Mercado Municipal de Bocas del Toro

notes: Red capital letters painted along the balcony fascia of the municipal market building, Bocas del Toro town, Isla Colón (camera 9.3418, -82.2404); frontal. No accent on COLON. Many distractor shop signs on the same facade: 'BOCAS PARTY SHOP', 'ROPA AMERICANA MICHAEL', 'MINI HELADERIA Y DULCERIA ANITA', 'Universal Com' (x3), 'BLOWER', 'RESTAURANTE TOM', 'CARIBBEAN SEAFOOD', 'REFRESQUERIA EBEN EZER', and a 'PROHIBIDO ESTACIONAR BICICLETA DENTRO DEL MERCADO' notice. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Katja Schulz from Washington, D. C., USA
attribution: Photo: Katja Schulz from Washington, D. C., USA, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rio_Mendoza_Sign_on_Pipeline_Road_-_Flickr_-_treegrow.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rusty yellow trail sign on a pole beside Pipeline Road (Camino del Oleoducto), Soberanía National Park (camera 9.1599, -79.7243); small in the frame and weathered. No accent is visible on RIO or SOBERANIA on the sign. The first letter of the fourth line (presumably C of CAMINO) is covered by a white blotch, so it is transcribed as 'AMINO DEL OLEODUCTO'; the final A of SOBERANIA is partly cut by the sign edge. 'INRENARE' is the former natural-resources agency. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Rio Mendoza Sign on Pipeline Road - Flickr - treegrow.jpg

author: Uviein
attribution: Photo: Uviein, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:3D_Panam%C3%A1_-30_dec_2018.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large multicoloured 3D letter sign 'PANAMÁ' (acute accent on the final A drawn as a separate block) on the waterfront by a marina in Panama City, skyline behind (no camera location; Commons category 3D letter place name signs in Panama). Small black text on the base, '#VISIT Panama' with social-media icons, is a secondary read.
source_categories: 3D letter place name signs in Panama

author: JurriaanH
attribution: Photo: JurriaanH, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bocas_del_Toro_greengrocer.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted script lettering on a turquoise fascia of a greengrocer in Bocas del Toro province (no camera location). 'Legumbrería' in red, the i carries a slanted stroke read as an acute accent (í); 'José' in blue with a clear acute accent. Large painted fruit mural at left, no other text.

author: Ulises Icardi
attribution: Photo: Ulises Icardi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Estadio_Armando_Dely_Vald%C3%A9s_(Col%C3%B3n).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large white 3D block letters on the facade of the football stadium in Colón (no camera location), seen at a steep angle; palm fronds partly cover the D and E of DELY. No accent on VALDES on the sign. A coat-of-arms medallion sits above.

author: gailhampshire from Cradley, Malvern, U.K
attribution: Photo: gailhampshire from Cradley, Malvern, U.K, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pijibasal_(42262089014).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted wooden plank (upper right) under a tiled shelter in the Darién (no camera location); black marker letters, small hut drawings and a red arrow. Distractor planks: 'Parque Nacional Darién / 3 Kms aprox', 'Pijibasal Community / to 400 mts aprox' (faded green), 'Accommodation Restaurant / Local Guide Handicrafts' and 'Hospedaje - Alimentación / Guías locales y Art...' (partly cut).
